title: Work IQ: invoke custom agents and agents that call third-party tools
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing and documented controls are supported, and its remaining gaps are narrowly stated. Two navigation clarifications remain: finish the policy route with the on/off setting, and acknowledge Microsoft's alternative agent-registry route through All agents.
